subject: Doré Evolution Run 001 — Design equipment discovery
body: Autonomously inspect the local environment and current design equipment candidates. Establish exact provenance/revision/license evidence for OpenPencil, Framesmith, Doop and Tela without requiring user terminal mediation. This is the first bounded equipment-discovery stage of Doré Evolution Run 001 and Doré Design 0.1. Return machine-readable evidence through the coordination outbox. Do not treat discovery as adoption; later stages must perform real-work create/edit/render verification.
